text: Just reporting that our payroll portal seems to have a fake lookalike login page circulating, several staff got the link this morning via email.
Just noticed a public GitHub repo from one of our developers has database credentials hardcoded in it, taking it down now, unsure how long it's been exposed
A caller asked for my account PIN saying it was for verification, I told him banks don't ask for that and ended the call.
An old backup drive that was supposed to be wiped and disposed of was instead sold as scrap electronics, we're trying to figure out if it still had data on it
we get alert say one account try access three different systems within two minutes, wey no normal for how our staff dey work
Pls help, I dey receive message everyday say my account go close if I no verify. Today one look almost real, I nearly enter my details but network cut before I finish
Someone accidentally attached the wrong file to a mass email, instead of the newsletter it included an internal spreadsheet with partial salary bands for three departments

just a heads up, one of our chatbot integrations logs full conversation transcripts including anything users type, even if they accidentally paste sensitive information, and we never reviewed where those logs are stored
The IT admin account was used to disable a security alert rule at 4am, none of the three people with access to that account were awake or working at that hour according to their statements
A USB drive that was plugged into one of the lab computers seems to have introduced something, that machine is now behaving strangely and won't boot properly.
Someone used a staff account to approve a purchase order for equipment nobody ordered, the actual staff member was on leave the entire week and had no access to their laptop.
nothing serious but a delivery person was seen taking photos of the building entrance and badge reader, security asked them to stop and they left without explanation
A colleague forwarded me a message claiming to be from our bank's fraud department, asking to call a number and confirm a transaction that never happened. She didn't call. Sharing for awareness.
URGENT-ish, someone tried the server room keycard access three times with a card that was reported lost two weeks ago
small thing but our office printer keeps randomly printing blank pages with strange codes on them since this morning, might just be a hardware glitch though
My login session appears to have been active in two locations simultaneously according to the activity log, one of them not anywhere near where I was.
dem tok say the virus enter through one USB wey somebody bring from outside plug for the lab computer, now three computers for that lab dey act up
we noticed unusual admin activity granting elevated permissions to a temporary contractor account that should have expired months ago, revoked access immediately
Update on the recurring WiFi device, network logs now show it also attempted to reach an internal file server twice yesterday.

just got a call from someone claiming to be from the telecom provider saying my SIM will be deactivated unless I share the code that was just sent to my phone. Hung up immediately, did not share anything.
small alert, one of our external-facing web pages is loading extremely slowly and occasionally redirecting to an unrelated site for a few seconds before loading properly, might be compromised
I don receive this same message three times now, dem dey pretend say na court summon, make you click link see full details. E be scam, I don report am for the group
just curious if anyone else got the email about 'mandatory 2FA setup' with a weird external link this morning, I didn't trust it so I didn't open it
Someone attempted to reset the password on the shared department email three times within ten minutes using the 'forgot password' link, none of us initiated it
Student records export with names and scores was found sitting on a public subdomain, indexed by search engines.

URGENT, our entire customer database export, including names, phone numbers, and partial payment info, was found on a public code repository uploaded by a developer who forgot to remove it before making the repo public
something no just correct, our internet don dey slow since this morning and nobody dey do anything heavy for the network as far as I sabi
I could not log into my staff account this morning, it says my password is wrong even though I haven't changed it. Tried resetting but the recovery email on file isn't mine anymore.
just noting this happened again, dem don try the same fake scholarship email trick on students for the third semester running, some students still dey fall for am unfortunately
Got a call asking me to read out an OTP for 'verification', I told them I wasn't comfortable and the line went dead immediately.
small thing, got a text message with a link claiming to be from the electricity company about an overdue bill, didn't click, we don't even have a meter registered with that name
system don show say virus dey but antivirus no fit remove am, e keep coming back anytime we restart the machine
The building's fire exit door, which has an alarm, was found propped open with no alarm triggered, unclear if the sensor failed or if it was intentionally bypassed
Somebody don upload the whole staff payroll file to a cloud storage account wey no get password, e dey there since last week before person notice am today
got an sms claiming to be from the university saying I won a scholarship, just need to click a link and pay a small verification fee. obviously fake, did not engage
Multiple staff reporting the same thing this morning: locked out of accounts, recovery details changed, no memory of doing it themselves. Might be connected.
URGENT - money don leave one staff account go one account wey we no recognize, the transfer show say e happen this morning around 7am while the actual staff say im dey sleep
I dey suspect say my login don compromise because my inbox get one folder wey I never create, and inside am get some email wey no be my style at all
I shared my staff login with someone who called claiming to be from head office doing a system audit, only realized after the call that we don't do audits that way.
A cloud storage bucket containing old audit reports has been publicly accessible, we're still figuring out how long it's been exposed.

A parent called to say they received an email supposedly from the school asking for updated payment details for tuition, wanted to confirm if it was legitimate before sending anything, it was not from us.
Not sure how serious this is but a colleague's laptop with unencrypted patient notes was left in a taxi, she's since reported it and we're trying to figure out what exactly was on there
Somebody on the phone asked for the OTP that just came to my number and I read it out to them without thinking.
Someone called asking for my card details claiming to be from the bank, I refused and hung up.
A caller convinced me he was my bank's fraud team and I gave him my account number and the code that came to my phone right after.
just a heads up, got a warning from our email provider that one of our addresses may be compromised and sending spam, we've reset the password as a precaution
Antivirus caught something trying to run at startup this morning and quarantined it before I even noticed anything wrong. Not sure what it was trying to do.
small issue, my laptop battery indicator shows it charging even when unplugged, might be a hardware fault but happened right after I opened a file someone sent me so wanted to mention it
One of the security cameras near the data center caught someone lingering by the server racks after hours who doesn't match any of our staff badges
one student complain say im matric number and result appear for one group chat wey no suppose see am, we still dey find out how e come reach there
An employee reported receiving a call from someone claiming to be doing a 'security audit' and asking oddly specific questions about our internal systems, they didn't answer and hung up
An IT ticket was submitted requesting access changes for a system, but nobody on the IT team recalls receiving or processing it, currently trying to trace where it originated
URGENT, ransomware has hit the student records database, files are inaccessible and there's a countdown timer in the ransom note threatening to delete everything if payment isn't made within 48 hours
